app_name: ResructAI / Blast-Damage Rehabilitation & Structural Engineering Assistant
context: Structural Engineering & Disaster Rehabilitation, offering AI-powered (GPT-5.4 Mini via Emergent LLM) multi-technique ranking, reasoning, urgency rating, material specification, safety notes, and professional disclaimer for blast-damaged structures.
archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast (Authority, Clarity, Truth) mixed with Performance Pro for engineering command center accuracy
key_features: Guided Blast-Damage Assessment Form (Component type, blast pressure/distance, crack width, spalling depth, steel reinforcement exposure, structural integrity status)
Optional Photo Upload & Base64 preview simulation for visual damage analysis
AI-Generated Ranked Rehabilitation Techniques (using GPT-5.4 Mini with Emergent LLM key)
Detailed Engineering Breakdown: Reasoning, Urgency, Materials list, Step-by-step procedure, Safety notes, Cost/Time estimate
Professional Structural Engineering Disclaimer & Liability Notice
Assessment History with local/backend persistence and PDF export or Report printing
instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all form inputs have explicit data-testid attributes. Use Sonner for toast notifications. Use Lucide React icons. Style with Tailwind CSS using clean structural engineering dashboard aesthetics. Implement both assessment creation and history viewing.
